scope: Review only. Production source unchanged. Probes run in an isolated source copy, with test code appended only; quota reproduction stops maintenance workers to retain unflushed WAL.

findings.title: Replication receiver globally over-reserves an indivisible log page and retries forever
Successful memory quota reduction can make all tenant reopening fail, including after Store restart
Failed tenant creation leaves unregistered databases that startup never removes
findings.fault: control directory not writable, restored before restart

findings.title: Concurrent backup staging double-counts active reservation and actual workspace

additional_source_verified_limit.detail: Existing-tenant checkpoint installation closes the gate before a second full copy and Engine verification. The 10s deadline only limits reader-drain polling, not that blocking I/O, as already documented. No transfer-time measurement or new defect claim.

limitations: Linux OrbStack only; no real power loss or physical device failure.
Focused reproductions, not a rerun of the full test suite.
No production fixes or remote publication in this review.
